subject: How do I define constrain code for multidimensional confirmatory model with 1pl

messages.author: 6da0318e35071d0d
messages.subject: How do I define constrain code for multidimensional confirmatory model with 1pl
parts:
Hello everyone
I want to make a parameters =1 in the syntax below. Anyone know the way around this?
Thank you in advance
Arif

library("mirt")

# 1PL MODEL----------------------------------------

model.1pl <- mirt.model('
JP = JP11-JP125
EI = EI11-EI124
FT = FT11-FT120
SN = SN11-SN120
COV = JP*EI, JP*FT, JP*SN, EI*FT, EI*SN, FT*SN')
result.1pl<- mirt(data=mb1, model=model.1pl,
                  method= "QMCEM", itemtype = NULL,
                  SE=FALSE, verbose=FALSE, optimizer= 'NR',
                  accelerate = "Ramsay")

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: How do I define constrain code for multidimensional confirmatory model with 1pl
parts:
You can use the START and FIXED keywords in the ?mirt.model syntax to do this. See the help documentation for examples.

Phil
